evidence: Extends the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper with script execution tracing callbacks and hooks across `src/kernel/` and kernel tests.
rationale: Adds build-time script evaluation tracing to the libbitcoinkernel C and C++ APIs, enabling external applications to inspect opcode execution step-by-step for debuggers and analyzers. Multiple reviewers and the author demonstrated working prototypes (such as rust-bitcoinkernel debuggers and visualizers) and highlighted its testing utility, but it is an auxiliary diagnostic feature rather than core kernel decoupling or validation API completeness.
